about: Plain names for the engine's features, for the console's evidence. 'common' serves every family; a family's own block names its order and process features and may override a common name. Keys are feature kinds without the HARMONIC_FEAT_ prefix, with ':label' for an order or process feature. What a feature points to comes from the knowledge graph, not from here.

common.VIB_CREST: Sharp spikes in the vibration (crest factor)
common.VIB_HARM_3X: Vibration three times per turn (3× speed)

gearbox.VIB_ORDER:mesh_sb: Gear-mesh tone pulsing once per turn

motor.VIB_ORDER:rotor_sb: Running-speed vibration pulsing at pole-pass frequency

fan.VIB_ORDER:bpf_sb: Blade-pass tone pulsing once per turn
fan.VIB_ORDER:x3: Vibration three times per turn (3× speed)
